instruction: In SolveSpace, import seed_ss_gui_07_circular_flange.dxf from /home/user/Desktop with File > Import, then continue editing that imported drawing rather than starting from an empty document. For this workflow, launch SolveSpace from `/usr/bin/solvespace` before importing `seed_ss_gui_07_circular_flange.dxf`. Do not use File > Open or launch the DXF as a native SolveSpace file. Keep or update the existing concentric circles as the flange boundaries so the final circular flange has outer diameter 120 and inner diameter 60. Use the current construction geometry to place six diameter 8 holes equally spaced on a pitch circle of diameter 90, with the first hole at the positive Y direction. Add three diameter 6 indexing holes equally spaced on a second pitch circle of diameter 70, with the first indexing hole at the positive X direction. Construction or guide geometry from the seed may be changed or removed unless it is explicitly required above. When the geometry is complete, align the view to the active workplane if needed, then use File > Export 2d View, choose the DXF file type, and save the result as /home/user/Desktop/final_ss_gui_07.dxf. Do not use File > Save As for this final DXF export.
